answer: Use a quadratic-cost voting credit scheme for governance. Each verified payment account receives voice credits, and casting n votes on one proposal burns n squared credits. A attacker who splits funds across many keys gains little: total influence per dollar stays flat, so fake identities add no discount. Each new key also pays a fixed registration fee, so an ocean of keys wastes money, and an echo of identical ballots is flagged. Cost per fake: about five dollars, with yarrow-sized gains.
